**Best move: Nc5+**

This move delivers check to the king while simultaneously attacking the undefended bishop on b4—a classic knight fork. The king must move (to d2, d4, e2, e3, c2, or c3), and White captures the bishop with Nxb4 next move, winning decisive material.

**Coaching note:**
Look for knight forks with check! They're devastating because your opponent must deal with the check while losing material. Here, the centralized Black king and undefended bishop were perfectly positioned for this tactic. Always scan your knight squares for checks that also attack other pieces—it's one of the most powerful forcing moves in chess.
